Place

GP, HSE point GP, geocoded Public hospital Private hospital Private clinic

GPs: HSE Find a GP, fetched 2026-10-16. 2,345 indexed, 2,087 plotted, 258 unmapped. Public hospitals: HSE Find a Hospital, fetched 2026-10-17, plus two Health Insurance Authority public hospitals with a published street. Private hospitals: HIA definitive list, August 2025, plotted only where a hospital site published a street address. Private clinics, specialist centres, day hospitals, and diagnostic clinics are taken from operator pages, including Affidea locations, Alliance Medical centre pages, Vhi 360 urgent care, Laya QuickCare, and UPMC sports and outreach pages, fetched 2026-10-17. Clinician counts, revenue, and specialties are stored only when a primary page states them. Unknown numbers are left unknown and drop out of the clinician filter. Website, phone, and email are the published contact on the HSE finder or the facility page cited in the inspector. Missing contacts stay unknown. A chief executive or managing director is stored only when the operator page, a filing, or a page that names that person in that role says so. The source sits under each leadership field. Missing names, emails, and LinkedIn URLs stay unknown. Heidi customer ticks are stored in this browser only. Nothing is ticked until you tick it. Private-site coordinates are Nominatim matches to the published address or the named facility. Unmatched addresses stay unmapped and are not drawn. Basemap tiles are Esri World Light Gray and need a network connection.

Timeline

Fourteen confirmed public records, earliest 9 March 2025. No opened page dates an Ireland launch. Unconfirmed items are left out.

  1. 9 March 2025
    Customer

    Western Rheumatology Partnership tells patients it uses Heidi

    The partnership published a patient notice that its consultants may use Heidi Health AI Scribe, with verbal consent, clinician review before saving, EU hosting, and GDPR compliance. This is the earliest dated Republic of Ireland customer evidence.

    wrh.ie/introducing-heidi-ai/

  2. 12 September 2025
    Partnership

    Socrates announces a collaboration with Heidi

    Socrates (Clanwilliam) said Heidi would be a Phase 3 partner, planned for year-end 2025, so practices with Heidi licences could use Heidi inside Socrates. Heidi called it the first integration with an Irish GP software system and said the work was still in discussion. This is an announcement, not proof it was live that day.

    socrates.ie

  3. 6 October 2025
    Other

    Series B names Ireland for clinician-led adoption

    Heidi announced a US$65 million Series B, valuing the company at US$465 million. The text says Heidi would build on clinician-led adoption in Ireland. Ireland is in that adoption list, not in the office and local-support list. The announcement is dated Melbourne, 6 October 2025.

    heidihealth.com · MobiHealthNews

  4. 17 December 2025
    Product

    Halaxy Ireland documents a live Heidi integration

    The Ireland help centre explains how practitioners enable the Heidi Health Scribe widget. The date is the page updated stamp. The original launch date is not published on that page.

    support-ie.halaxy.com

  5. 15 January 2026
    Other

    An Irish GP protocol says ARQ practices routinely use Heidi

    HRB Open Research describes the ARQ Practice-Based Research Network, a collaboration between RCSI and Centric Health. Participating practices have Heidi in routine workflow, and GPs in the network using Heidi (n=30) would be invited to a survey. Individual ARQ practices are not named.

    hrbopenresearch.org/articles/9-11

  6. 29 January 2026
    Launch

    Heidi Health Ireland Limited is incorporated

    CRO 807346, registered office Floor 3, Block 3, Miesian Plaza, Dublin 2, D02 Y754. This confirms an Irish legal entity. The register address is not evidence of a staffed Dublin office.

    sraideolas.com · Privacy policy

  7. Removed 12 February 2026
    Hiring

    A remote Product Manager role was advertised in Ireland

    Built In Dublin listed Product Manager, Upmarket & Integrations, hiring remotely in Ireland. The listing was removed on 12 February 2026. The original posting date is not on the page. This is not evidence of a Dublin office.

    builtindublin.ie

  8. 9 March 2026
    Customer

    Bayview Family Practice tells patients some of its GPs use Heidi

    The Donegal practice, with sites in Ballyshannon and Bundoran, published a notice by Conor Mitchell that some of its GPs use Heidi AI Scribe to transcribe consultations and generate notes and letters.

    bayviewfamilypractice.ie

  9. 8 April 2026
    Partnership

    PortmanDentex signs a two-year partnership, UK and Ireland

    PortmanDentex said it would deploy Heidi across the organisation in the UK and Ireland, after a pilot in selected practices. The announcement names no Irish practice, town, or Ireland-specific rollout number. IT Brief Ireland covered it on 10 April 2026.

    heidihealth.com · IT Brief Ireland

  10. 30 April 2026
    Product

    Ireland legal documents go up on the en-ie site

    A Privacy Policy and Usage Policy were published 30 April 2026 for Ireland in English, both updated 4 September 2026. Terms of Use were updated 31 July 2026. The terms are in euros, under the law of Ireland and the EU, and name Heidi Health Ireland Limited.

    heidihealth.com/en-ie/legal

  11. Removed 23 September 2026
    Hiring

    A Forward Deployed Engineer role was advertised for Ireland

    Built In listed Forward Deployed Engineer, Ireland, hiring remotely in Ireland, to embed with enterprise customers. The listing was removed on 23 September 2026. The original posting date is not on the page.

    builtin.com

  12. 25 September 2026
    Customer

    Heidi quotes a County Clare GP on Heidi Evidence

    A blog post quotes Dr John, principal GP for his clinic in County Clare. The clinic is not named, and the GP is named only as Dr John. This is a testimonial, not a named customer.

    heidihealth.com

  13. Undated
    Customer

    Galway Bay Medical Centre tells patients it has introduced Heidi

    The Dock Road practice has a patient page saying it has introduced Heidi, with GP review before saving and an opt-out. No publication date is on the page, so it is not given a month. The page was live on 18 October 2026. A claim of Irish College of GPs support is the practice's own wording.

    galwaybaymedicalcentre.ie

  14. Undated
    Product

    The Ireland pricing route and Irish GP templates are live

    Heidi serves an Ireland storefront at en-ie, including pricing and the Irish legal entity in euros. Ireland templates include Irish GP Medicolegal Report and GP Note NorthWest Ireland, created by Conor Mitchell. A last-edited stamp of 2/10/2026 is not treated as a launch date. Confirmed live on 18 October 2026.

    Pricing · WriteUpp · GP Note NorthWest Ireland
